items.title: Meta unveils AI-powered game tools for mobile devices and browsers; announces VR Glasses with day-one Unity support
items.excerpt: Horizon Centre and Horizon Studio will "make it easier to turn your ideas into playable 2D and 3D games"

items.title: Injecting DLSS 5 Into The Witcher 3 Remastered Gives Geralt a Much-Needed Facelift, but Costs Up to 30% Performance
items.excerpt: We've hooked NVIDIA DLSS 5 into The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered with intriguing results, both in visuals and performance.

items.title: SecretSauce Labs' Simon Davis on leaving games behind and solving AI's brand consistency problem
items.excerpt: Wearemighty is leaving game development behind and rebranding as SecretSauce Labs, shifting its focus entirely to AI content technology

items.title: Insomniac denies AI made Marvel's Wolverine's weird bathroom sign - blames a "UV map bug" instead
items.excerpt: Insomniac denies using generative AI on Marvel's Wolverine after fans spotted a strange bathroom sign, blaming a "UV map bug" instead.

items.title: MiHoYo wins $112,000 in Genshin Impact AI voice cloning lawsuit
items.excerpt: A Shanghai, China-based court ruled that a genAI voice synthesizer developer infringed on MiHoYo's copyright on Genshin Impact.

items.title: Dueling industry surveys show Japanese game devs are embracing AI, while North American ones are still skeptical
items.excerpt: Two industry surveys point in opposite directions: Japan's CESA finds 85.8% of Japanese game developers use generative AI at work, while North American developers remain markedly more skeptical.

items.title: Level-5 Announces Fixes For AI-Generated Presentation
items.excerpt: According to Level-5, many of the perceived 'AI slop' elements in its recent presentation were due to the rushed nature of the Nintendo Direct, and were not AI-generated

items.title: Your guide to the official Unity plugin for Claude Code
items.excerpt: Unity walks through installing its official plugin for Claude Code, the pipeline architecture, and a live demo in which Claude Code reads and drives the Unity Editor at runtime for prototyping gameplay and managing scenes.
